components.text: The Demon Dungeon's rooms are built almost entirely out of an odd pale-blue material unknown in the rest of reality, dubbed "Demon Stone." It comes in a wide decorative family - plain stone, polished and tiled variants, bricks, small bricks, cracked bricks, pillars, stairs, walls, fence gates, slabs, and light-emitting Demon Eyes - all generated naturally throughout the dungeon.

Most of the family also comes in four Will-tainted color variants - Corrosive, Destructive, Steadfast, and Vengeful - matching whatever Will corrupted that part of the dungeon. These are purely decorative reskins of the same shapes, not separate mechanics.
